# README assets

The screenshots in this directory show the actual Mac Manager interface, captured on 2026-10-18 from the local 0.8.9 (13) development build.

- `screenshots/overview.jpg`: the English Overview screen with live local hardware readings. The app was launched with isolated UI-test preferences and synthetic clipboard data; no personal clipboard content or IP address is shown.
- The app icon is referenced directly from the versioned Xcode asset catalog.

The images are product illustrations, not evidence of a completed release or a full accessibility audit. Keep future screenshots limited to the app window and use isolated or synthetic data for private features.
